description: Your Toast order history, newest first: each order's GUID, restaurant (GUID, name, ordering link), when it was placed (ISO-8601 UTC, plus the restaurant's time zone), dining option and status as Toast reports them, item count with the first few items, and total in dollars. Pass next_page_token from the previous answer for older orders. Use toast_get_order for a full receipt. Needs a toast.app sign-in in the browser running ContextMint Bridge.

next_page_token.description: From a previous answer, to fetch the next (older) page.

view.description: compact (default) returns the shaped result; "full" returns the Toast gateway's raw `data` object untouched. "brief" returns one line per order: restaurant (dining option, item count) — <when placed, ISO date-time, or "no date"> — <status>. The lines ride in the untrusted-data envelope as `data` (restaurant names are the restaurants' own text). Note lines start with "-- ": "-- none" when there are no orders, "-- error: …" when Toast reported a partial failure, "-- more" when older orders exist (call again with view "compact" for next_page_token).

name: toast_list_orders
